prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1461; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the other vehicle struck our client's car while our client was turning left. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter, including any requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, to this office. Do not contact our client directly.

We request that you provide the policy number and the bodily injury liability limits for every policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this collision, along with the name of the adjuster assigned to the claim.

We also demand that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics, claim file materials, witness statements, and any recorded calls. Please confirm in writing that a litigation hold has been placed on these materials.
